newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks quiet trade, Tallinna Pank down.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks quiet trade, Tallinna Pank down.

text.p: Trade in Tallinna Pank shares was the key to Friday's market, with other shares undergoing small corrections, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index lost 0.54 percent to close at 194.21 on turnover of 34.6 million kroons on the official list.
Tallinna Pank was the most active stock on the market registering trade of 11.6 million kroons to close at 69.15, 5.10 down on Thursday.

Other stocks were quieter. Saving Bank turned over 7.4 million kroons to firm slightly at 92.25 kroons, up 0.10 kroons. Hansapank underwent a minor correction to ease 0.50 kroons to 182.50 with a turnover of six million kroons.
Forekspank also dipped to close one kroon lower at 151.10 after a trade of 2.9 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market registered 6.7 million kroons of activity with most stocks easing.
Tallinna Kaubamaja department store had the highest trade with three million kroons to close 0.20 kroons lower at 85.05.
Rakvere meat plant was down 0.15 kroons at 15.25 kroons with 1.6 million kroons of shares traded.
